Co-op & Game Sync

Game-specific multiplayer compatibility

Browser sync unavailable

Current embedded version

This panel loads the game from another website. The hub cannot read or change the game's internal player, enemy, boss, or save state from a cross-origin iframe, so a lobby button here alone would not produce real co-op.

To sync actual gameplay, both players need the same multiplayer-capable game build plus its networking integration. This UI won't pretend a connection exists.

Existing mod options

Verified multiplayer projects are listed here when found. These links describe mods for compatible installed game versions, not for the current browser embed.

Invite mutual-follow friends

Only accounts that follow you and are followed back appear here. This sends a hub/game invitation; it does not create in-game synchronization by itself.

Sign in and connect to load friends.

🎮 Connect Controller

0%
Waiting for your controller...
Xbox: hold the ☰ Menu button (the three lines) for 3 seconds.
PlayStation: hold the big middle PS button for 3 seconds. If your computer grabs the PS button, hold ☰ Options instead.
Once connected: D-Pad / left stick moves, A / ✕ selects, B / ○ goes back, LB / RB switch tabs. Selecting a text box opens the controller keyboard.

Import a Playlist

From Spotify (on your home computer): go to exportify.net, log in with Spotify, press Export next to your playlist, and pick the .csv file below.
From Apple Music / iTunes: click the playlist, then File → Library → Export Playlist..., save it as a .txt file, and pick it below.
It saves to your Silk account, so it's there on every computer you sign in on.
⚠️ Your playlist has to be public to add it. Silk can only read playlists that anyone with the link can see.
Apple Music: open the playlist, tap ··· → Edit, turn on Show on My Profile and in Search, then ··· → Share Playlist → Copy Link (or Copy Embed Code on a computer).
Spotify: open the playlist, tap ··· → Add to profile (or Make public), then Share → Copy link to playlist (or Embed playlist → Copy on a computer).

Account Settings

This list is local to this browser. Sign in with the same account on another browser to pull cloud-synced profile data and encrypted Silk data.

Silk auto-syncs its own settings, AI chats, lesson position, saved links, profile preferences and game selection after sign-in. Open this file in Edge first and use “Use this device as latest save” once to promote Edge’s current Silk data; the same account on other devices then restores the cloud copy. Embedded games’ own save databases are separate unless each game supports save export or cloud sync.

Silk syncs its own account settings, chats, saved links, and lesson progress automatically after sign-in while online. Third-party game saves and multi-gigabyte game assets are separate and cannot be moved by Silk's account sync.

Important: Silk cannot read a different website’s private iframe storage, so it cannot automatically copy Cuphead/Hollow Knight browser saves or their large game caches by itself. Each browser may need to download game assets again. Use a game-specific save export/import feature if that player provides one; Silk’s account sync covers Silk-managed data.

You're right — asking for the old password doesn't help when you've forgotten it. Silk cannot reveal the original because it stores a password check value, not readable text. While you're signed in, you can replace it here without entering the old one.

The authenticated VERR account has owner controls. Removing VEER clears the copy saved in this browser and attempts to clear its retained account record if the old account key is available here.
